Name: FFXIV Paladin Cape for Fashion Sense
Author: LooneyLuny
Description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/3Ffvnd3.png[/img]﻿[center]I created this for my friend so his Paladin oath could be extended to Stardew Valley. The cape is fully animated, but not colorable. I locked the color options to keep the cape accurate without having to mess around with the sliders to get it there. I may add a colorable version later if people are interested.

If you notice anything that looks odd about it or not lining up right, leave a comment and I'll look into fixing it. :)




[img]https://i.imgur.com/B92L7co.png[/img]

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]Fashion Sense[/url]﻿!
Unzip the file and drop the folder, [FS] Paladin Cape by Luny, into your StardewValley/mods folder.
It'll now appear in the Fashion Sense menu.﻿
[/center]
